q025.question: What groups are included among the beings of Trinity origin?
q025.answer: According to the material presented, beings of Trinity origin constitute a certain Paradise group and include the following groups: • Trinity Teacher Sons [1, 19:0.2] • Perfectors of Wisdom [1, 19:0.3] • Divine Counselors [1, 19:0.4] • Universal Censors [1, 19:0.5] • Inspired Trinity Spirits [1, 19:0.6] • Havona Natives [1, 19:0.7] • Paradise Citizens [1, 19:0.8] With the exception of the Trinity Teacher Sons and possibly the Inspired Trinity Spirits, the number of members in these groups is fixed; their creation is finished, an event of the past. The Havona natives and the vast hosts of beings residing on Paradise (the Paradise citizens) are also included in this classification of Trinity-origin personalities. The Havona natives and the Paradise citizens are sometimes collectively called the Paradise-Havona personalities. These beings all originate in the Paradise Trinity and represent the administrative policies, justice, and executive judgment of the Paradise Trinity throughout the grand universe. The divine Trinity designed them to fulfill specific duties, and they are qualified to render this service. They are all of Trinity origin and were created with Paradise perfection and all the divine attributes. A brief description of each group follows: • Trinity Teacher Sons: the only revealed group of Sons of God originating in the Paradise Trinity, and the only beings who act in a dual capacity. They are liaison beings who bridge the universe gap between the Trinity-origin personalities and the dual-origin personalities. They are assigned throughout the central universe and the superuniverses, and they also serve on individual planets. They are the highest co-ordinate personalities of Trinity origin. Their function is to devote themselves almost wholly to the service of the divine Sons. Their number is continually increasing. • Perfectors of Wisdom: a specialized creation of the Paradise Trinity designed to personify the wisdom of Deity in the superuniverses. They do not reflect the wisdom of the Paradise Trinity; they are that wisdom itself. They are the sources of wisdom for all the teaching bodies of learning and insight in all the universes, the fountains of discretion and the source of discrimination. They are permanently assigned to the service of the Ancients of Days and devoted to the administration of the superuniverse governments. They can take part in practically all celestial service on behalf of ascending mortals. • Divine Counselors: the counsel of Deity to the worlds of worlds of the seven superuniverses. They do not reflect the counsel of Trinity Deity; they are that counsel. They are the associates and equals of the Perfectors of Wisdom and the Universal Censors. They take part in the governments of the Ancients of Days and in the councils of the local universe, constellation, and local system rulers. Together with the Perfectors of Wisdom and the Universal Censors they constitute the tribunals of Trinity divinity, which are known as the most astute counseling bodies in the universes of time and space. Their verdicts are as if the Ancients of Days had spoken. • Universal Censors: the very judgment of Deity. They do not merely reflect the decisions of perfection; they are the judgment of the Paradise Trinity itself. Even the Ancients of Days do not sit in judgment except in association with the Universal Censors. They are active in every division of the central universe and the seven superuniverses, and they are an organic part of all dispensational adjudications of the evolutionary worlds. They are personalities of the unifying function of the universe, and their pronouncements show the sum and substance of divine conclusions, final and perfect decisions. When he speaks, no one can gainsay. The Universal Censors seem to be in some way related to the Deity Absolute. • Inspired Trinity Spirits: one of the almost wholly secret orders of beings. They come into existence by the act of the Paradise Trinity, and they may also arise from one, two, or all three of the Deities. Their nature and conduct are not at all understood, and they probably belong to the category of superpersonal spirits. They appear to operate throughout all known circuits and to work well independently of time and space. They have no place in which they can be clearly revealed in the present dispensation or in the administration of the seven evolving superuniverses. They are the secret of the Paradise Trinity. There is a conjecture that they function, by superconscious techniques, as teachers of reality.

q026.question: What is God the Supreme?
q026.answer:
1. Definition and role of God the Supreme. God the Supreme is defined as follows and performs specific functions within the grand universe of time and space. The evolutionary and experiential God: God the Supreme is Deity actualizing and evolving in time and space. Unlike the Paradise Deities (Father, Son, and Spirit), who are existentially eternal, this being is in the process of experiential actualization. Creator and creature unity: The level of function of God the Supreme is that of "⟦Q 0:1.9⟧self-experiential and creature-Creator-unifying Deity⟦/Q⟧." This Deity is the personal God who experientially achieves the unification of creature and Creator in time and space. Controller of the grand universe: God the Supreme is regarded as Deity functioning on the first creature-identificational level as time-space overcontroller of the grand universe. This being is the synthetic co-ordinator of the evolving universes and is sometimes regarded as the Supremacy of Deity. Fusion of the finite and the infinite: When finally actualized, this evolutionary Deity will constitute the eternal fusion of the finite and the infinite, "⟦Q 0:7.9⟧the everlasting and indissoluble union of experiential power and spirit personality⟦/Q⟧."

2. The relationship of God the Supreme to divine reality. God the Supreme is closely associated with the Paradise Deities and with other divine concepts. Relationship with the Paradise Trinity (from potential to actual). The experiential expression of Paradise Deity: Since the Universal Father has now revealed existential Deity in the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit, he is now also expressing himself experientially on nonpersonal and unrevealed levels as God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and God the Absolute.

Actualization of potential: God the Supreme was a potential in the Paradise Trinity, and from it he derives his personality and his spirit attributes. But he is now actualizing in the Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, and the Master Spirits. The manifestation of spiritual unity. Unification of spirit reflection: The Supreme God in Havona is the personal spirit reflection of triune Paradise Deity. This Deity relationship is now creatively expanding outward as God the Sevenfold and is being synthesized in the grand universe into the experiential power of the Almighty Supreme. Unification of power-personality: Paradise Deity exists in three persons and is therefore evolving experientially in two phases of Supremacy, and these two phases are eventually unified as the power-personality of the one Lord God the Supreme Being. Role in the creature ascension plan. The goal of ascending creatures: Finite reality in time and space comes to take part in an ever-ascending direction under the guidance of the evolving Supreme Being. Bearer of reality: Reality as comprehended by finite beings is partial, relative, and shadowy. The maximum Deity reality comprehensible by evolutionary finite creatures is embraced within the Supreme Being.

3. The attributes and status of God the Supreme. Experiential evolution: God the Supreme, as a Deity who evolves and experiences like the creatures evolving in time and space, personally experiences the achievement of unification with Deity. This being was not eternal in the past but is eternal only in the future, an eternity bound by time and space. Not a direct creator: God the Supreme is not a direct creator, except that he is the father of Majeston. Part of God the Sevenfold: God the Supreme is mentioned fourth among the levels of God the Sevenfold (the Paradise Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, the Seven Master Spirits, the Supreme Being, God the Spirit, God the Son, God the Father), and this God the Sevenfold is the functional Deity that enables finite time-space beings someday to become power-personalized in the Supreme Being. In summary, God the Supreme is the controller of the grand universe and the personal God who comes into being and evolves in the process by which finite creatures attain perfection through experiential union with Deity, and ultimately he is the being who unifies all the experiential values of the finite creation.

q027.question: What is the origin of the Infinite Spirit?
q027.answer:
The origin of the **Infinite Spirit** lies in the divine united act of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. The Infinite Spirit is the third divine person constituting the **Paradise Trinity**, an unlimited and eternal being.

1. The origin of the Infinite Spirit (the joint act of the Father and the Son). The Infinite Spirit sprang into existence as the eternal interdependence and the recognition of absolute oneness between the Universal Father and the Eternal Son took concrete form. The dawn of eternity: When the "first" infinite and absolute thought of the Universal Father found in the Eternal Son a perfect and adequate divine expression [8:0.1], there arose the supreme desire of both the Father and the Son for a universal and infinite agent of mutual expression and combined action [8:0.1]. The covenant of partnership: In the dawn of eternity the Father and the Son became infinitely cognizant of their mutual interdependence and their eternal absolute oneness, and they entered into an infinite and everlasting covenant of divine partnership [8:0.2]. The moment of springing forth: "⟦Q 8:0.3⟧The eternity origin of the Infinite Spirit, the Third Person of Deity⟦/Q⟧": the very instant that God the Father and God the Son conjointly conceive an identical and infinite action—the execution of an absolute thought-plan—the Infinite Spirit springs full-fledgedly into existence [8:0.3]. The execution of the absolute thought-word union: According to [8:3.1], the Infinite Spirit is "⟦Q 8:3.1⟧the perfect execution of the "first" completed creative concept or plan for combined action by the Father-Son personality partnership of absolute thought-word union⟦/Q⟧." Eternal coexistence: On the philosophic value-level, the text teaches that the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit are just as eternal as the "I AM." In other words, it teaches that there never was a time when the I AM (the Universal Father) was not the Father of the Son and of the Spirit [0:3.23].

2. Status as a divine personality. Although the origin of the Infinite Spirit lies in the joint act of the Father and the Son, he is regarded as a unique and equal divine personality derived from them.

The Third Source and Center: The Infinite Spirit is called the Third Source and Center [8:2.2], and like the Universal Father (the First Source and Center) and the Eternal Son (the Second Source and Center) he is perfectly and unqualifiedly one with them [8:2.1]. Reflection of nature: The Conjoint Creator (the Infinite Spirit) perfectly reflects not only the nature of the Paradise Father but also the nature of the Original Son [8:2.1]. Conjoint personality: The Infinite Spirit is the conjoint personality, the unique personal consequence of the everlasting Father-Son union [10:2.4], and functions as the God of Action who executes the united thought of the Father and the Son [8:1.1]. Bestowal of personality: Because the Infinite Spirit does not reach the ultimate creative level at which all personalizable potentials are exhausted and divinity is completed, he also bestows personality not of Father origin. In this case the Infinite Spirit does so for himself, in creative association with the Eternal Son [9:8.10].

3. Other concepts related to the origin. Relation to the Isle of Paradise: When there occurred the differentiation of the Son from the Father and their coexistence in the presence of the Isle of Paradise, the person of the Infinite Spirit appeared and the central universe of Havona came into being [0:3.22]. The Isle of Paradise has no personality and is nonspiritual, but it is the absolute pattern of the material reality of the universe [0:5.5]. The Infinite Spirit, as the conjoint representative of the Father-Son and the executive of their partnership, is known to bring into being the cosmic absolute mind [9:4.2]. Figurative understanding: The origin of the Infinite Spirit is like the eternal birth of the **action that actually carries out the idea in the real universe (the ministry of the Infinite Spirit)**, when one primal idea (the Father's thought) and the perfect language that expresses that idea (the Son's word) are joined together. The Infinite Spirit is the active personality who executes this divine plan.

q028.question: What effect have historical events such as the Lucifer rebellion had on human evolutionary and spiritual development?
q028.answer:
The effect of historical upheavals such as the Lucifer rebellion on the evolutionary and spiritual development of the human beings of Urantia was, at first, serious confusion and delay; in the long run, however, it produced the paradoxical result of heroic loyalty and an ultimate increase in cosmic good.

1. Negative effects on evolutionary and spiritual development (confusion and delay) The Lucifer rebellion and the betrayal of Caligastia turned Urantia aside from the normal path of planetary evolution and brought serious deprivation and confusion upon mankind.

• Social and moral confusion: The Caligastia rebellion precipitated world-wide confusion and robbed all subsequent generations of the moral assistance which a well-ordered society would have provided [34:7.4].

• Intensified biological and spiritual conflict: Even more tragic was that the Adamic default (Adamite default) deprived the races of a superior type of physical nature which would have been more consonant with spiritual aspirations [34:7.4]. Because of this, Urantia mortals are compelled to undergo marked struggling between the spirit and the flesh [34:7.5].

• Decline of civilization: For almost fifty years after the rebellion, great confusion reigned in and around Dalamatia, and there was an attempt to substitute revolution for evolution as the policy of cultural advancement and racial improvement [67:5.1]. As a result, indescribable confusion and racial chaos appeared among the outlying peoples, and among the half-evolved primitive men liberty quickly degenerated into license [67:5.1].

• Planetary isolation: The people of Urantia now live on a backward and confused planet [52:6.8], a world that was plunged into a hopeless state of confusion by evil and sin [76:5.7].

• The final result of sin: Deliberately nurtured evil (rebellion) is at last governed by the universal law of **eternal extinction (death)** [46:8.4, 67:7.1].

2. Spiritual heroism through the rebellion and ultimate victory In spite of these upheavals, the ordeal of the rebellion ultimately laid the foundation for spiritual victory and devotion on a universe scale and promoted long-term good.

• The heroic loyalty of Amadon: The Lucifer rebellion was checked on many worlds of Satania, but Amadon is described as the outstanding personality of the whole system [67:8.1]. He remained steadfast and unshaken in his loyalty to the invisible Father and to the supremacy of his Son Michael [67:8.1]. For seven long years, the first question of all subordinate celestial life was: "⟦Q 67:8.3⟧What of Amadon of Urantia, does he still stand unmoved?⟦/Q⟧" [67:8.3].

• The far-reaching influence of loyalty: This inspiring performance by Amadon and his 143 comrades has done more good than the sum total of all the evil and sorrow in the universe of Nebadon and the superuniverse of Orvonton [67:8.4].

• Michael's bestowal (the ministry of Christ): Urantia is a planet bound up with a Creator Son (Michael), and his bestowal mission caused this world to become known as "the world of the cross" [76:5.7, 41:10.5]. The darkness of the planet became the dark background that led to its choice as the stage on which the loving personality of the Father in heaven was revealed, and Urantia must in the end be regarded as having gained everything [76:5.7].

• Experiential gain: Every being who withstood the test of the Lucifer rebellion at once had his administrative status advanced and his spiritual value enhanced [54:6.5]. The Melchizedeks now teach that the good resulting from the Satania rebellion is more than a thousandfold the sum of all the evil [54:6.6]. These historical events brought delay and suffering to human evolution, but at the same time they served to demonstrate, on a universe scale, the heroic worth of loyalty and faith expressed in the midst of extreme adversity, and through Michael's bestowal they opened the way to final spiritual restoration. It was like the most difficult of cosmic trials, one that forges a strong spiritual character.

q029.question: What core structures and concepts does The Urantia Book present concerning the universe, divinity, and creature ascension?
q029.answer:
I. Core concepts of Deity The Urantia Book presents Deity as the Paradise Trinity and describes the Universal Father as the source of all things.

1. The Universal Father The Universal Father is the First Source and Center of all creation [6:1.1], and he is understood as the Creator, Controller, and infinite Upholder [3:2.2].

• Nature and attributes: God is **universal spirit** [1:3.1]; he is eternal truth, infinite reality, and father personality. The glory and spiritual brilliance of the personal presence of Deity are inaccessible to any order of material personality [1:3.3]. His power and wisdom are wholly adequate to meet any universe emergency [3:2.6]. His power may be limited by his infinite love [3:2.11] and by his will and law [3:2.11].

• Control and upholding: He is the controller of matter, mind, and spirit [3:2.2]; he upholds all things by the word of his power and keeps cosmic disintegration from occurring [3:2.2].

• Indwelling presence: One of the most unfathomable mysteries of the Father is his residence in the minds of the creatures of time through the indwelling **Thought Adjuster** [5:3.2]. This Adjuster helps mortal man to evolve an immortal soul [1:3.7].

• The importance of personality: He exercises sovereign will [3:6.7], and through his personality circuit he maintains parental contact with all his creatures [10:3.14]. Only through fellowship with a personal God can man begin to comprehend the unity of Deity [3:6.3].

2. The Eternal Son The Eternal Son is the complete expression of the Universal Father's "first" personal and absolute concept [7:6.3], and he is the Second Source and Center [6:1.2].

• The ministry of mercy: The Son is the great minister of mercy to all creation [6:3.2], and the essence of his spiritual personality is mercy [6:3.2]. Mercy is the application of love, the Father's love in action in the person of the Eternal Son [6:3.4].

• Spiritual gravity: The Eternal Son is the source and center of spiritual gravity [7:3.2] and is the basic channel through which genuine prayer is carried to the level of divine reality consciousness [7:3.3, ].

• The Creator Sons: A Creator Son is the personification of the creative thought of the Father and the Son [7:6.3] and becomes the sovereign ruler of a universe of time and space (a local universe) [7:6.4].

3. The Infinite Spirit The Infinite Spirit is the Third Source and Center [10:2.4] and is called the Conjoint Creator (Conjoint Actor), or the God of action [8:6.7, ].

• Source of mind: The Infinite Spirit is the source of absolute mind [6:6.4] and the absolute administrator in the realm of mind.

• Cosmic manipulator: The Infinite Spirit is responsive to both physical and spiritual energy [9:3.1], and he possesses the unique and amazing power of antigravity [9:3.2]. He is not the source of energy, but he is the manipulator of energy [9:3.5].

4. The Paradise Trinity The Paradise Trinity exists as the Deity union of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit [10:4.4] and functions on a universe scale as one unified Deity [10:3.16]. The Trinity functions as one in relation to all universe reality, and its unity is perfect [2:2.4]. Their union brings about the evolution and emergence of new meanings, values, powers, and capacities for all universe reality [10:5.2]. II. Core concepts of cosmic structure The Urantia Book presents a vast concentric universe structure centered on Paradise.

1. The central universe: Paradise and Havona

• Paradise: It is the fixed and absolute geographic center of all things [12:1.10] and the absolute source of all energy-matter [12:8.2]. It is composed of a single form of materialization, a fixed system of reality [11:2.9].

• Havona: The central universe that immediately surrounds Paradise. Havona is the workshop and playground of the finaliters [14:6.39], and it is capable of serving as a training universe in future universe ages as well [14:6.41].

2. The grand universe and the superuniverses

• The grand universe: It consists of the central creation (Havona) and the seven superuniverses [15:2.2]. Our superuniverse is the seventh superuniverse, Orvonton [15:3.14].

• The local universe: The basic unit of superuniverse organization is a system of about one thousand worlds [15:2.3]. Each local universe is ruled by a Creator Son of the order of Michael [21:3.1].

• Outer space levels: In the vast regions beyond the seven superuniverses, still greater future creations are in process of formation [12:2.5], and these regions are at present outside the rule and administration of the superuniverse governments [12:2.5].

3. Universe force and energy

• The force organizers: The Paradise force organizers transmute space potency into primordial force and are the originators of nebulae [29:5.5, 24:5.5, 15:4.4].

• Universe expansion: All seven superuniverses, together with the outer zones of the whole universe, take part in space respiration with a cycle of two billion years [12:4.12]. (The cited material does not contain 12:4.12; see the rotational motion described at 15:3.14.)

• Gravity: All forms of force-energy are wholly subject to the control of the universal presence called gravity [12:3.1]. Physical energy is the one reality that is true and steadfast in its obedience to universal law [12:8.3]. III. Core concepts of creature ascension The Urantia Book presents a divine plan for the eternal survival of mortal man and for his attainment of perfection.

1. The goal of perfection and the eternal adventure

• The divine command: The transcendent goal of finite man is to find the eternal God and to comprehend the divine nature [2:2.5]. The ultimate command is **"⟦Q 26:9.3⟧Elle a prouvé ainsi que le plan d’ascension était praticable et démontré pour toujours la justice et la droiture du commandement du Père Universel à ses humbles créatures des mondes : « Soyez parfaits comme moi-même je suis parfait. »⟦/Q⟧."** [26:9.3, 26:11.4, 26:4.12].

• The motive of ascension: Death is the beginning of a career of endless adventure, and curiosity and the desire for discovery are God-given endowments [12:2.6, 20:6.40].

2. The path of the ascension journey

• The choice of survival: When the human mind is taught and led by the spirit, the mind associated with matter is transformed into the soul, an immortal morontia reality [1:3.7]. The eternal survival of personality depends wholly on the choice of the mortal mind [1:3.7].

• The morontia career: After death the surviving mortal is personalized in a new morontia form on the **mansion worlds (transition spheres)** [30:4.15, 30:4.17]. The mansion worlds are the spheres to which Jesus alluded when he said: "⟦Q 30:4.17⟧In my Father's house are many mansions⟦/Q⟧." [30:4.17].

• The Havona pilgrimage: The ascending pilgrims pass through the seven Havona circuits, making spiritual progress on each circuit [26:3.2]. The pilgrim who reaches Havona arrives with only the perfection of purpose, and his faith has been tested [26:4.13].

• Arrival on Paradise: When they finish the Havona pilgrimage and reach Paradise, they are at last mustered into the Mortal Corps of the Finality [30:4.31, 30:4.32]. Faith has won for the pilgrim a perfection of purpose and leads him to the portals of eternity [26:4.14].

3. The Corps of the Finality

• The Mortal Corps of the Finality is made up mostly of ascending mortals who have fused with their Adjusters [31:3.1], but it also includes nonmortal personalities such as adopted seraphim, Havona natives, and Material Sons [31:3.1, 31:4.1, 31:5.1].

• They are beings trained to honor the merciful and just principles of administration of all the universe creations of time and space [31:3.7].

• They are at present recorded as spirits of the sixth stage of spiritual progress [31:3.4], and their future destiny and mission are surmised to relate to service in unknown superfinite realms [31:3.8, 31:10.13, 31:3.3]. The oath of the Mortal Corps of the Finality is administered by the chief of the Transcendentalers, the head of the Architects of the Master Universe [31:8.1].

q030.question: What is the ultimate path by which finite creatures evolve to reach the experiential Deities and the Absolutes?
q030.answer:
The ultimate path by which finite creatures evolve to reach the experiential Deities and the Absolutes is the **Paradise ascent**. It is a journey that passes through **God the Sevenfold**, experientially realizes **God the Supreme** and **God the Ultimate**, and finally moves on toward **God the Absolute (Absolute Deity)**.

1. The origin of mortals and the beginning of the ascent Finite reality is created life and is subject to the limitations of time and space [0:1.11]. The personality of mortal man is neither body, mind, spirit, nor soul; it is the unique bestowal which the Universal Father makes upon the living and associated energy state of matter, mind, and spirit [0:5.21].

• Acquiring an immortal soul: The human soul is an experiential acquirement [0:5.20]. The finite, material mind becomes the "mother," and the spirit of God that indwells the mind (the Thought Adjuster) becomes the "father"; and when the finite creature chooses to do the will of the Father in heaven, a new reality, the soul, comes into being [0:5.20].

• The destiny of Paradise ascent: This emerging immortal soul is destined to survive death and to begin the Paradise ascension [0:5.20].

• The guidance of the Supreme Being: Finite reality in time and space comes to share in a constantly ascending trend under the guidance of the evolving Supreme Being [0:7.10].

2. Approaching experiential divinity through God the Sevenfold To help the limitations and status of finite beings, the Universal Father has provided for the evolutionary creatures a sevenfold approach to Deity [0:8.1, 0:8.9]. This God the Sevenfold is the functional Deity of finite evolutionary creatures [0:8.9].

• The composition of God the Sevenfold: God the Sevenfold includes the Paradise Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, the Seven Master Spirits, the Supreme Being, God the Spirit, God the Son, and God the Father [0:8.1].

• The path of the ascension career: The experiential career of God-discovery begins with the recognition of the divinity of the Creator Son of the local universe of Nebadon [0:8.9]. From there it ascends by way of the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse and by way of one of the Seven Master Spirits [0:8.9].

• Reaching Paradise: This ascent continues until it finally achieves the discovery and recognition of the divine personality of the Universal Father on Paradise [0:8.9].

3. Integration with God the Supreme The ministry of God the Sevenfold is for the Paradise ascension career, so that finite creatures may someday become power-personalized in the Supreme Being [0:8.9].

• Definition of the Supreme Being: God the Supreme is the actualizing, evolving God of time and space, the personal Deity who experientially achieves the oneness of creature and Creator [0:2.12].

• Ultimate fusion: The Supreme Being personally experiences the achievement of Deity unity as the evolving and experiencing God of the evolutionary creatures [0:2.12]. When his actualization is finally completed, this evolutionary Deity will constitute the eternal fusion of the finite and the infinite (the union of experiential power and spirit personality) [0:7.9].

• The attempt toward absonite levels: By participating in the power-personality synthesis in the Supreme Being (the union of time-space experience with spirit personality), finite reality begins its attempt to reach absonite levels beyond the creature level [0:7.10]. In the association of God the Sevenfold, the Supreme Being provides the technique whereby the finite may attain absonite status and, through yet another possible future actualization, attempt the attainment of the Ultimate [0:8.11].

4. Progress toward God the Ultimate and the Absolutes After integration with the Supreme Being, the creature advances to the absonite levels that transcend time and space.

• The realization of God the Ultimate: God the Ultimate is the eventuating God of time-transcending and space-transcended Deity [0:2.14]. God the Ultimate designates personal Deity functioning on the divinity levels of the absonite and on the universe spheres of supertime and transcended space [0:9.2].

• Ultimate service-destiny: The eventuation of God the Ultimate is designed to provide an ultimate service-destiny for all the creatures of time and space who have attained absonite levels through the ministry of God the Sevenfold [0:9.1].

• The goal of God the Absolute: God the Absolute is the realization-attainment goal of all superabsonite beings [0:10.2]. The actualization of God the Absolute would be the consequence of the unification of the Absolute Trinity, the second experiential Trinity [0:10.1].

• The role of the Universal Absolute: The finite can coexist in the cosmos along with the Infinite only because the associative presence of the Universal Absolute so perfectly equalizes the tensions between time and eternity, finite and infinite, man and God [0:11.13]. This ultimate path of ascent is brought to completion by the ministry of the Creator Sons, which provides a way for the finite to be embraced by the infinite, and by the guidance of the Supreme Being, who helps finite reality to participate in all its phases and values and to achieve complete union [0:8.11, 0:7.10].

q031.question: Why were the conditions of the first-century Roman Empire favorable to Jesus' mission?
q031.answer:
1. Why were the conditions of the first-century Roman Empire favorable to Jesus' mission?

The political and cultural environment of the time offered the best possible conditions for spreading the gospel. Unity of language and culture: The Greek language and culture were widely spread, so communication flowed easily even between different peoples. Roman infrastructure: Thanks to well-built roads and seas free of pirates, messengers could travel quickly and safely. The dispersion of the Jews: The synagogues scattered throughout the Roman world became footholds where "the gospel of the kingdom of heaven" could first be introduced.

2. How did Jesus' upbringing affect his relation to this multicultural environment? In the course of growing up, Jesus naturally acquired the qualities of a citizen of the world. The location of Nazareth: Nazareth was a crossroads where caravan travelers stopped, and there Jesus came into contact with many different races and cultures. Language ability: Jesus was competent not only in Aramaic but also in Greek, so he had no difficulty conversing with most travelers. Travels in the world: He traveled widely in the Mediterranean region, meeting people of every class, from the rich to the poor, and learning to love them.

3. What influence were philosophies and religions other than Judaism having on people at that time? The existing systems served as soil for the new teaching. Philosophical preparation: Greek philosophy led people away from nationalistic beliefs and toward the pursuit of personal salvation and high moral ideals. Spiritual longing: Because the gentile religions of the time did not fully satisfy the individual's spiritual longings, Jesus' teaching about personal spiritual experience could reach people all the more powerfully.

q032.question: What kind of place is Ascendington?
q032.answer:
**Ascendington** is the seventh of the Universal Father's seven secret spheres, located between Paradise and Havona, and it is called the **"⟦Q 13:1.21⟧bosom of the Father, Son, and Spirit⟦/Q⟧."** This unique world is the gathering place of the ascendant creatures of space and the actual Paradise home where the pilgrims of time, on their way to Paradise, stay while they pass through Havona. The details concerning Ascendington are as follows.

1. The home of ascending mortals Place of rest and education: Mortals who reach Havona spend most of their Havona "vacations" here, taking part in thousands of activities beyond mortal imagination. Permanent address: Even after they become finaliters and reside on Paradise or serve in outer space, Ascendington always remains their permanent home address. Throughout all eternity mortals will regard it as the home of their sentimental memories and reminiscences. The one open sphere: Ascendington is the only sacred sphere that humans who have arrived on Paradise can examine and enter without restriction. (By way of reference, the first world, Divinington, is forever closed to mortals.)

2. The secret of Ascendington (soul evolution) The evolution of the immortal soul: The central secret of this world concerns the mystery of the gradual formation, within the material and mortal mind, of a spiritual and immortal counterpart (the soul). Exclusive experience: Because this mysterious process is the exclusive experience of the human order of existence, one seventh of Ascendington is closed even to high Trinity-origin beings such as the Divine Counselors. An eternal secret: Even after mortals reach Ascendington and fully understand this secret and receive its revelation, it remains their own eternal secret, not disclosed to other orders of beings.

3. Administration and operation Leaders: Ten Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy, the highest order of the Stationary Sons of the Trinity, direct this world. They reflect the unified character of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. A place of fellowship: Trinity-origin beings sometimes leave their homes near the Most Holy Sphere and appear here on Ascendington, where they fraternize with their mortal brethren who have come up from the lowly worlds of space. Future role: It is inferred that if outer universes are created in the future and inhabited by creatures with ascension potential, they too will look upon Ascendington as their Paradise home world. In summary, Ascendington is the spiritual center that connects the lowly worlds of mortal origin with the perfection of Paradise, a sacred place where the mysterious history unique to human beings, of how they fuse with the divine Adjuster and are reborn as immortal beings, is preserved.

q033.question: What is the origin of the Isle of Paradise?
q033.answer:
Descriptions of the origin and coming into being of the Isle of Paradise appear in several places; the main points are as follows.

1. Simultaneous appearance in the eternal past The Isle of Paradise is described as an eternal existence with no beginning in time. Specifically, it is depicted as appearing simultaneously with the "first act" of the Universal Father in personalizing the Eternal Son. The **I AM** achieved personality by becoming the Father of the Original Son and at the same time the eternal source of the Isle of Paradise. When the Universal Father expressed his spirit self as the Eternal Son, he simultaneously revealed the infinite potential of his nonpersonal self as Paradise.

2. A nonpersonal, nonspiritual expression of Deity The Isle of Paradise is defined as deriving from Deity, yet not being Deity itself nor a spiritual being. Paradise is the first nonspiritual expression of the First Source and Center (the Universal Father). The nucleus of the Isle is a derivative of Deity but cannot be called Deity; it is described as appearing to be an inevitable repercussion of the Father's will and act in eternalizing the Son. The Universal Father is the direct ancestor and source of Paradise.

3. The absence of any record of its origin Paradise is one of the oldest realities in the universe, an existence that lies beyond the history of physical creation. Paradise has existed from eternity, and there are neither records nor traditions respecting the origin of this Isle. The Paradise-Havona system constitutes the perfect and eternal nucleus of the master universe; it is not a creation of time but an eternal existence.

4. "Beginning" in the philosophical sense The text uses the concept of a "beginning" to help finite human understanding, but it emphasizes that in reality Paradise has always existed. It explains that, in order to show the origin of universe reality, events that took place simultaneously in eternity must necessarily be presented as successive events. Paradise is the absolute source of all energy-matter and the only stationary thing in the universe; it does not move. In summary, the Isle of Paradise is described as the first material and absolute reality, which appeared as the projection of the nonpersonal aspect of Deity at the very eternal moment in which the Universal Father brought the Eternal Son into existence.

q034.question: I would like to know more about the administrative meaning of Urantia's universe number 666.
q034.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, the number 666 is the final part of the official universe registry number assigned to identify our planet, Urantia, within the administrative system of the grand universe. Its administrative meaning is set out in detail below.

1. Urantia's official universe address Urantia is recorded in the official registry system of Paradise and of Uversa, the superuniverse capital, under the following thirteen-digit number. Full registry number: 5,342,482,337,666 This number is not merely a symbolic figure; it functions as a kind of "cosmic postal code" or **"unique identification number"** indicating Urantia's location within the vast administrative organization of the grand universe.

2. Administrative hierarchy and location This number reflects the hierarchy of the great administrative universe units to which Urantia belongs. The Urantia Book defines Urantia's administrative location as follows. The seventh superuniverse (Orvonton): the great superuniverse unit to which we belong. The fifth major sector (Splandon): one of the ten major sectors within Orvonton. The third minor sector (Ensa): one of the one hundred minor sectors within Splandon. The eighty-fourth local universe (Nebadon): one of the one hundred local universes within the minor sector of Ensa. The seventieth constellation (Norlatiadek): one of the one hundred constellations within Nebadon. The twenty-fourth local system (Satania): one of the one hundred local systems within Norlatiadek. Inhabited planet number 606: the order in which it is registered as a human-inhabited planet within the system of Satania. Note: Its number within the system is 606, but the final registry number entered in the overall list of inhabited worlds kept by the higher administrative authorities, Uversa and Paradise, ends in 666.

3. The precision of administrative care The existence of this number means that Urantia is officially recognized and precisely administered by the universe government. Individual administration: Urantia is just one among countless worlds, yet, registered under this number in the universe records, it is "⟦Q 15:14.9⟧just as precisely administered and just as lovingly fostered as if it were the only inhabited world in all existence⟦/Q⟧." Registration of will: On the basis of this number the Census Directors keep a real-time account of all the intelligent life on the planet, registering a being with "will" (a human being) when it first appears on Urantia and recording it when its life comes to an end. In summary, 666 has nothing to do with the ominous prophecy of the Bible; it is legal and administrative evidence that Urantia has been incorporated into the orderly administrative system of the grand universe and is under the protection and supervision of the Creator and the universe rulers.

q035.question: Please tell me about the origin, kinds, and roles of the seconaphim.
q035.answer:
The **seconaphim** are ministering spirits who work in the seven superuniverses, an angelic host that performs a role similar to that of the supernaphim of the central universe or the seraphim of the local universes. The details about them are as follows.

1. Origin and organization Origin: They are created by the **seven Reflective Spirits** assigned to the headquarters of each superuniverse. Organization: Seconaphim are always created in groups of seven, and each group is always composed in the ratio of one primary, three secondary, and three tertiary. Characteristics: As offspring of the Reflective Spirits, they have the **"reflective ability"** inherent in their nature. They serve as "living mirrors" that instantly reflect the responses of beings who take origin in the Infinite Spirit or in the Paradise Creator Sons.

2. Place of activity Main abode: They have their headquarters on the headquarters worlds of the seven superuniverses (for example, Uversa, the capital of the seventh superuniverse, Orvonton). Range of activity: Centered on the superuniverse capital, their sphere of service reaches upward to connect with the central universe and Paradise, and downward as far as the borders of the local universes.

3. Kinds and roles of the seconaphim (1) Primary seconaphim (Primary Seconaphim) They directly serve the Ancients of Days, the rulers of the superuniverse, and act as channels that instantly report conditions in distant places. There are seven types: The Voice of the Conjoint Actor: interprets and represents the mind of the Infinite Spirit (the Conjoint Actor) at the superuniverse headquarters. The Voice of the Seven Master Spirits: reveals the collective nature and reactions of the Seven Master Spirits. The Voice of the Creator Sons: reflects the mind and attitude of the Creator Sons, such as Michael of Nebadon. The Voice of the Angelic Hosts: responds to the feelings and attitudes of angels of every order, from the supernaphim to the seraphim. Broadcast Receivers: synchronize special messages coming in through the universe communication circuits with the reflective images. Transport Personalities: carry the pilgrims of time from the superuniverse headquarters to Havona (the central universe). The Reserve Corps: a large body held in readiness for unclassified assignments and emergencies. (2) Secondary seconaphim (Secondary Seconaphim) They are attached to the Trinity-origin administrators (the Perfectors of Wisdom, the Divine Counselors, and the Universal Censors) who assist the Ancients of Days. Attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom: the Voice of Wisdom (transmits the co-ordinated wisdom of the universe), the Soul of Philosophy (projects the philosophy of Paradise), and the Union of Souls (promotes ethical relationships and teamwork). Attached to the Divine Counselors: the Heart of Counsel (integrates wisdom and counsel), the Joy of Existence (induces joy in men and angels), and the Satisfaction of Service (inspires the value and reward of service). Attached to the Universal Censors: the Discerner of Spirits (instantly perceives the motives and spiritual nature of beings and so assists just judgment). (3) Tertiary seconaphim (Tertiary Seconaphim) They are assigned to the ascendant Trinitized Sons of the superuniverse government (the Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those without Name and Number) and are chiefly concerned with the ascending pilgrims. The Significance of Origins: serves as a living genealogy of the origin and present status of every being. The Memory of Mercy: a living record showing the measure of mercy extended to an individual and his spiritual condition. The Import of Time: teaches the profitable use of time (work and rest) and gives counsel that forecasts future events. The Solemnity of Trust: accurately weighs an individual's capacity for responsibility and trustworthiness and so assists in assignments. The Sanctity of Service: analyzes the true motives and unselfishness of service and reveals its value. The Secret of Greatness & 7. The Soul of Goodness: evaluate and teach, in complementary fashion, greatness and goodness, the process of becoming like God.

4. Summary of main functions Living records: Unlike the official records, they preserve the spiritual values of the universe perfectly in their own minds through their reflective ability. Gathering and distributing information: They function as a system that gathers the news of all creation and distributes the decrees. Guidance of ascension: They reflect the knowledge and wisdom that the pilgrims of time need as they pass through the superuniverse and are responsible for their transport to Havona, thus becoming key companions on the ascension journey.

q036.question: The Andromeda nebula and the Andronover nebula
q036.answer:
1. The Andronover nebula: mother of the solar system The Andronover nebula is described as the direct origin and ancestor from which our solar system arose. Origin of the solar system: The nucleus of the physical system to which our sun and its planets belong was once the center of the Andronover nebula. Form and changes of the nebula: Andronover was originally a spiral nebula. But around the time the solar system was born, the gravitational disturbance caused by the close approach of a huge neighboring nebula slightly distorted its form, and it eventually became a somewhat globular aggregation. Location of the solar system: Despite this near collision, the double-file arrangement of the suns was not entirely destroyed. Our solar system now occupies a fairly central position in one of the arms of this distorted spiral, located about halfway from the center toward the outer edge. Rotational motion: Our solar system follows an orbit revolving around the nucleus of the former Andronover nebula. In addition, this Andronover stellar family and its associated clusters swing around the composite rotation-gravity center of the Nebadon nebula.

2. The Andromeda nebula: an active nebula outside the superuniverse The Andromeda nebula is described as a very active nebula existing outside the superuniverse to which we belong. Location: Andromeda is a nebula located beyond the borders of Orvonton, the superuniverse in which we live. Activity: At present there are not many nebulae within Orvonton that are actively forming suns, but Andromeda, outside the superuniverse, is forming suns very actively. Observation: This far-distant nebula can be seen with the naked eye. Distance of light: It is explained that when we look at the Andromeda nebula, its light left those distant suns almost one million years ago.

3. General characteristics of nebulae (background information) Creators: Nebulae are initiated by the Paradise force organizers. They set up enormous cyclones of force around the space presence, causing the ultimatonic units of universe matter to appear, and these become the spiral and other forms of nebulae (the mother wheels of solar systems). Classification: In outer space ten different forms of nebulae can be observed as stages of primary universe evolution. In summary, the Andronover nebula is the former spiral nebula that gave birth to our solar system, and the Andromeda nebula is a nebula outside our superuniverse that is at present very actively making new suns.

q037.question: What is the present condition of the Andronover nebula?
q037.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, **the great Andronover nebula no longer exists today in the form of a nebula** [1]. The details concerning the end of the Andronover nebula and its present condition are as follows.

* **The end of the nebula and the birth of the sun**: The Andronover nebula began to break up with an enormous final explosion about eight billion years ago, and this process continued for about two billion years [2]. **Six billion years ago**, with the completion of the terminal disruption of Andronover, the nebula passed away, and at that time **the sun**, the center of our solar system, **was born** [3]. Our sun was the fifty-sixth from the last star born of the second solar group of Andronover [3].

* **Survival as a legacy**: Although the nebula itself has disappeared, Andronover is still, so to speak, alive in the **1,013,628 solar systems** born of that mother cloud and in the planetary families attached to them [1, 3]. The nucleus of the physical system to which our solar system belongs was once the center of the Andronover nebula [4].

* **The last nuclear remnant**: The last **nuclear remnant** of the once magnificent nebula still remains today in the form of a **reddish sun** [1]. This heart of the ancient nebula still gives forth gentle light and heat to the **165 planetary families** that revolve around it [1]. In summary, the Andronover nebula ended its physical life as a nebula and broke up about six billion years ago, but it maintains its traces through the countless stars derived from it, through the planets, including our solar system, and through its last nuclear remnant, which is still shining [1, 3].

q038.question: Please tell me in detail about the origin, roles, and special features of the supernaphim.
q038.answer:
The **supernaphim** are the highest order of angels, serving on Paradise and in the central universe (Havona). They are the most divine and able beings among the angelic hosts made up of the children of the Infinite Spirit, and according to their origin and role they are divided into three orders, as follows.

1. Origin of the supernaphim The supernaphim are divided into three orders according to who created them. Primary supernaphim: Children created by the Infinite Spirit (the Conjoint Actor) acting alone, they are superb ministers who directly serve the Deities on Paradise. Secondary supernaphim: Beings created individually by the Seven Master Spirits, they support the ascending mortals and the Paradise citizens on the seven circuits of Havona. Tertiary supernaphim: Angelic specialists created by the Spirits of the Havona circuits, they manage the complex affairs of the central universe and care for the pilgrims.

2. Main roles and orders of service Each order works in seven highly specialized functional groups. Primary supernaphim (Paradise service): They are the last teachers the ascending mortals pass through before becoming finaliters. They are divided into Conductors of Worship, Masters of Philosophy, Custodians of Knowledge (living libraries), Directors of Conduct, Interpreters of Ethics, Chiefs of Assignment, and Instigators of Rest. Secondary supernaphim (guides of the Havona circuits): They lead the pilgrims passing through Havona one step at a time. They serve as Pilgrim Helpers, Supremacy Guides, Trinity Guides, Son Finders, Father Guides, Counselors and Advisers, and Complements of Rest. Tertiary supernaphim (operation of the central universe): They take charge of the technical operations and the information of Havona. They consist of the Harmony Supervisors, Chief Recorders, Broadcasters, Messengers, Intelligence Co-ordinators, Transport Personalities, and the Reserve Corps.

3. Special features and unique character Perfect but not absolute beings: They are perfect beings who have never once departed from the paths of light and righteousness, yet they are neither absonite nor absolute beings. Spiritual polarity and co-operation: Except in assignments directly concerned with the Universal Father, they usually work in **voluntary pairs** in order to carry out their functions. Transcendent speed of travel: They move much faster than seraphim, approaching the speed of flight of the Solitary Messengers, and can travel almost free of the limitations of time and space. Custodianship of knowledge: In particular, the Custodians of Knowledge among the primary supernaphim are called **"the living libraries of Paradise"**; all the facts and truths of the universe are recorded in their minds, so that error is essentially impossible for them. Help in sleep and transformation: They play an essential role, as Instigators of Rest and Complements of Rest, in the "last transition sleep" which mortals undergo when they graduate from Havona to be resurrected eternally on Paradise. The supernaphim are the noblest spiritual companions and teachers whom mortals meet on their journey from the lowly beginnings of animal origin to the divine perfection of Paradise.

q039.question: What is the connection between the Seven Master Spirits and the seven Spirits in the Bible's Book of Revelation?
q039.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, the "seven Spirits of God" described in the biblical Book of Revelation are an actual reference to the Seven Master Spirits, who are central to universe administration, and at the same time they are also closely connected with the **Seven Adjutant Mind-Spirits** of the local universe. The specific connections and The Urantia Book's interpretation are as follows.

1. Direct connection with the Seven Master Spirits Confirmation of the biblical record: The Urantia Book states that the Seven Master Spirits are the personalized physical power, cosmic mind, and spiritual presence of the triune Deity, and that the biblical record of **"⟦Q 16:4.1⟧the Seven Spirits of God sent forth to all the universe⟦/Q⟧"** is literally true. Position before the throne: Just as Revelation describes the seven Spirits as being before the throne, the Seven Master Spirits maintain their personal headquarters and power focuses on the periphery of Paradise, the center of all things, and from there they supervise the universes. Representatives of the Infinite Spirit: They are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, and outside Paradise the Infinite Spirit speaks only through the voices of these Seven Master Spirits.

2. The Urantia Book's reinterpretation of John's vision The Urantia Book explains that the vision seen by the apostle John captured a real glimpse of the spiritual world, but that it mixed together information from different levels of universe administration. The seven adjutant mind-spirits: The "seven spirits of God," "⟦Q 34:4.11⟧like lamps burning before the throne⟦/Q⟧," which John saw in vision, are closer to a symbolic view of the seven adjutant mind-spirits bestowed by the Divine Minister (the Mother Spirit) of the local universe than to the Seven Master Spirits of the grand universe. These adjutants are called the spirits of wisdom, worship, counsel, knowledge, courage, understanding, and intuition. Confusion of administrative levels: The Urantia Book points out that the record in Revelation confuses phenomena of the universe headquarters (Salvington) with those of the system headquarters (Jerusem). For example, the **"four and twenty elders"** around the throne are not at the center of the universe but refer to the **twenty-four counselors on Jerusem**, the headquarters of the system of Satania to which Urantia belongs. The directional control creatures: The "four beasts" described by John actually symbolize the **directional control creatures (living universe compasses)** that work on Salvington, and they operate on the universe currents with the help of the adjutant spirit of intuition (quick understanding).

3. Summary The Urantia Book explains the symbols of Revelation by connecting them with cosmic realities. **"The seven Spirits of God"** in the broad sense signify the power of the Seven Master Spirits, who administer the whole universe, and in the more particular sense they represent the ministry of the seven adjutant mind-spirits, which awaken human intelligence. That is, the symbolic expressions of the Bible are grounded in the actual activities of graded divine personalities who distribute the intelligence of the universe and assist spiritual progress.

q040.question: Please explain in detail the four cosmic reality realizations inherent in human self-consciousness.
q040.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, human self-consciousness is in essence a communal consciousness between God and man, Father and son, Creator and creature, and within it the following four universe reality realizations are latent and inherent.

1. The quest for knowledge (the logic of science) Through self-consciousness man seeks to grasp the relations of cause and effect in the physical world. This springs from the capacity of an intelligent creature endowed with cosmic mind to recognize, mathematically or logically, the uniformity of physical causation. Through it man discerns the **facts** and **laws** of God.

2. The quest for moral values (the sense of duty) Within human self-consciousness lies a reasoned recognition of the duty of moral conduct. This is not merely a matter of intelligence; it comes from the moral nature indigenous to human personality, and it is a judicial form of cosmic discrimination that recognizes relative right and wrong in the arena of reason.

3. The quest for spiritual values (religious experience) Through self-consciousness man longs to recognize spiritual reality experientially. This appears as the worshipful fellowship with Deity, grasped by faith, that is linked with loving service to mankind. Such spiritual insight leads to the recognition of the reality of divine values and provides assurance of eternal survival.

4. The quest for personality values (divine fatherhood and human brotherhood) This realization includes two essential recognitions. Recognition of the personality of God: the ability to recognize God not merely as energy but as an actual personal reality. Realization of the brother relationship: as one becomes conscious of God as the Creator Father, one becomes conscious of other human beings as creature brothers. This is a universe reality made possible for all moral creatures through the universal personality circuit. The cosmic meaning of the realization of self-consciousness These four elements are the innate recognition-realizations given to the personal creature endowed with cosmic mind and indwelt by the Thought Adjuster. Of all human experience, apart from the intuitive validity given to the unification of the cosmic reactions to these three (energy, mind, and spirit realities), everything else is indeed subjective. The God-knowing mortal, co-operating with the indwelling spirit of the moral mind in the process of evolving an immortal soul, can sense the unified value of these cosmic qualities.

q041.question: What are the seven groups of Supreme Spirits?
q041.answer:
1. Groups of Trinity origin (children of the Paradise Trinity) Seven Master Spirits: The primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, they represent the seven possible associations of the Trinity and, on Paradise, act as the central supervisors of the seven superuniverses [16:0.1, 16:3.1]. Seven Supreme Executives: Created by the Trinity and the Master Spirits, they are the administrative co-ordinators of the grand universe, carrying out on the Paradise satellites the divine plans determined by the Master Spirits [17:1.1, 17:1.4]. Reflective Spirits: Forty-nine beings of Trinity origin, they carry on the central ministry of universe reflectivity at each superuniverse headquarters, preserving and transmitting information [17:2.1, 17:3.1, 17:3.5].

2. Groups of origin in the Infinite Spirit and creative associates Reflective Image Aids: Created by the Reflective Spirits, they become the personal voices of the Reflective Spirits and serve as channels of communication with the superuniverse authorities [17:4.1]. Seven Spirits of the Circuits: The joint impersonal representation of the Infinite Spirit and the Master Spirits, they supervise the seven circuits of the central universe of Havona and co-ordinate the conduct of celestial affairs [17:5.1]. Local Universe Mother Spirit: The local universe personalization of the Infinite Spirit, she is the spiritual mother who co-operates with the Creator Son in creating and managing the life of the local universe [34:1.1, 34:3.4]. Adjutant Mind-Spirits: The seven mind impulses created by the local universe Mother Spirit, they provide intellectual and moral ministry to the material minds of the evolutionary worlds [36:5.1, 36:5.2]. Beginning with the Seven Master Spirits of Paradise and reaching down to the adjutants bestowed upon the evolutionary minds of time and space, these spirits organically connect and unify the administrative system of the grand universe [17:0.10, 17:8.1].

q042.question: What is the system of space potency, absoluta, segregata, ultimata, monota, triata, and tranosta?
q042.answer:
According to the record of The Urantia Book, **space potency** and **absoluta** are not different concepts but different names for the same reality. The specific details of their relationship and nature are as follows.

1. Two names for the same reality Space potency: A functional name for the free space presence of the Unqualified Absolute. It signifies the potential, pre-reality state that contains the totality of all cosmic reality. Absoluta: The official name by which space potency is called on Uversa, the superuniverse capital. That is, it is stated plainly that **"⟦Q 42:2.6⟧Sur Uversa, la puissance d’espace s’appelle absoluta.⟦/Q⟧."**

2. Characteristics of space potency (absoluta) Origin and nature: It is the first nonspiritual expression of the First Source and Center (the Universal Father) and the actual substance of which the Isle of Paradise is composed. This substance is neither dead nor alive; it is the state in which all the absolute potentials of cosmic reality are concentrated. Controlling agent: It belongs to the domain of the Unqualified Absolute, but it is a "pre-reality" stage that responds ultimately only to the **personal grasp** of the Universal Father. Cosmic function: It is the ancestor of all physical materialization and signifies the most primal force-charge state before it is transformed into "primordial force" (segregata) by the Paradise force organizers.

3. Relationship to the other energy stages Space potency (absoluta): the state of the space presence of the Unqualified Absolute, which does not respond to gravity. Primordial force (segregata): the stage in which space potency is first changed, by the presence of the force organizers, from a passive state into active, primitive force. Emergent energies (ultimata): the stage in which primordial force is further refined and begins to respond to Paradise gravity. In summary, as your question suggests, space potency and absoluta are not separate realities; both refer to the potential of cosmic force inherent in the Unqualified Absolute, and absoluta is Uversa's own name for that potential. This stage is the most primal nonspiritual reality, the foundation of all material creation.

**Absoluta, segregata, ultimata, and gravita** represent the descending, evolutionary stages by which energy is materialized in the evolutionary universes of time and space (the seven superuniverses). By contrast, **triata** and **tranosta** are energy systems that function on other cosmic levels (the levels of the central universe and of Paradise).

1. Triata: the energy of the central universe, Havona Nature: Triata is the energy system peculiar to the central universe (Havona). Structural difference: Unlike the energy of the superuniverses (gravita), which is "dual" in constitution, made up of positive and negative, triata has a "threefold" (triune) constitution. Hierarchical position: As energy is traced inward toward Paradise, one passes beyond the gravita stage of time and space and meets the triata stage. This is the existential energy domain of the Conjoint Actor (the Infinite Spirit).

2. Tranosta: transcendental energy Nature: Tranosta is classified as a transcendental energy system. Sphere of operation: This energy operates only on the upper level of Paradise and functions only in connection with absonite beings, who are neither finite nor absolute. Relational meaning: If triata is the level of the central universe, tranosta signifies energy activity on a transcendental level that is more fundamental still and closer to Paradise.

3. The overall relationship of the energy systems (in descending order) Universe energy can be understood as divided into the following levels, from its origin on Paradise to the outermost edges of time and space. Monota: the living, nonspiritual energy of Paradise, closest to divinity. Tranosta: the transcendental, absonite energy stage of the upper level of Paradise. Triata: the threefold energy system of the central universe, Havona. Gravita: the dual (electrical) energy used in the seven superuniverses, that is, what we call physical "power." The stages preceding the formation of this gravita are precisely the process you asked about: **absoluta (space potency) → segregata (primordial force) → ultimata (emergent energies)**. Summary and conclusion Absoluta through gravita are the stages of an evolutionary process by which infinite potential changes into finite matter. Triata is the existential energy of the central universe, which already exists in perfection before that evolutionary process begins. Tranosta is a special form of energy that acts on the transcendental level between the finite and the absolute. Therefore, rather than a single linear sequence, it is more accurate to understand these as energy systems that are named and administered differently according to the **levels of the universe (Paradise, the transcendental level, the central universe, and the evolutionary universes)**.

q043.question: What are the differences between the Big Bang theory of the birth of the universe and the teaching of The Urantia Book?
q043.answer:
The Big Bang theory of modern science and the process of the birth and evolution of the universe described in **The Urantia Book** share the phenomenon of the expansion of the universe, but they differ fundamentally in origin, mechanism, and purposiveness. The main differences, based on the source material, are summarized below.

1. Origin: accidental explosion vs. intelligent plan The Big Bang theory: It generally regards the universe as the product of a great explosion that occurred by chance some 13.8 billion years ago from a single point of extremely high temperature and density. The Urantia Book: It maintains that the universe is not an accidental product but an intelligent mechanism planned and controlled by infinite mind. The source of all matter and energy is the Isle of Paradise, and organization begins as the Master Force Organizers, in accordance with the will of the Universal Father, transmute primordial force into energy capable of materialization.

2. Mode of expansion: one-way expansion vs. space respiration The Big Bang theory: It is the theory that, since its birth, the universe has continued to expand in all directions from a single point. The Urantia Book: It explains that the universe does not simply keep expanding but exhibits the phenomenon of "space respiration," alternately expanding and contracting in cycles of two billion years. After the universe expands horizontally for about one billion years, it goes through a process of contracting again during the next billion years. The present expansion of the universe that mankind observes is only one phase of this vast respiratory cycle.

3. The age and structure of the universe: a starting point vs. an eternal center The Big Bang theory: It holds that the universe as a whole has a finite age of about 13.8 billion years. The Urantia Book: The core of the universe, **the central universe of Havona**, is an eternal existence without beginning or end. Only the seven superuniverses to which we belong and the universes of outer space are regions that evolve and are organized in time and space. Considering that the history of the Andronover nebula, to which Urantia belongs, already began 875 billion years ago, it presupposes a far longer history of the universe than science predicts.

4. The nature of energy and matter The Big Bang theory: It focuses on the physical change by which particles were formed and became matter as energy cooled. The Urantia Book: Energy is a real manifestation proceeding from the Universal Father, and matter is simply **"organized energy."** Moreover, the process by which energy is materialized is not merely a physical phenomenon; it is a process of transformation finely regulated by intelligent beings, the **power centers** and the physical controllers.

5. The definition of empty space The Big Bang theory: Space itself is sometimes regarded as created along with the expansion of the universe, or as an empty state. The Urantia Book: Space is never empty; it is filled with a reality called **"space potency."** Space does not respond directly to gravity, but it acts as a buffer that slows and neutralizes the speed at which matter and energy are drawn toward Paradise, helping the universe to maintain equilibrium. In summary, whereas the Big Bang theory is the result of observing the physical phenomenon of the expansion of the universe, The Urantia Book emphasizes the intelligent designer behind that expansion (respiration), its source in the eternal Paradise, and the vast system of universe administration that unifies matter and spirit.

q044.question: What is the relationship among ultimata, gravita, and the ultimaton?
q044.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, **ultimata, gravita, and the ultimaton** represent the successive stages by which energy originating on Paradise becomes materialized in the evolutionary universes of time and space. Their relationship is explained below, focusing on the key points.

1. Ultimata (emergent energies) Ultimata is the stage of emergent energy just before universe force turns into "matter." Nature: It is the energy stage that first begins to respond to the circular and absolute gravity of Paradise. Composition: On Uversa (the superuniverse capital), the two stages of "puissant energy" and "gravity energy" are together called ultimata. Response to gravity: Energy at this stage responds to the direct pull of Paradise (absolute gravity), but it does not yet respond to the linear gravity that acts between individual planets or suns.

2. The ultimaton The ultimaton is the most basic physical unit of material existence. Energy stage: The ultimaton is the first measurable form of energy particle formed at the ultimata (emergent energy) stage. Mother of the electron: One hundred ultimatons are bound together by mutual attraction to make up one **electron**. Characteristics: The ultimaton fully obeys the circular pull of Paradise (absolute gravity), but it does not respond to the linear gravity between material masses. That is, until it is organized into electrons, it has no weight (no response to linear gravity).

3. Gravita (universe power) Gravita is the universe power stage, in which energy has passed through the electronic stage of materialization and has become fully responsive to linear gravity. Nature: It is the state in which energy has been organized into electrons and atoms and has become the actual "matter" we recognize. Response to gravity: At this stage it is subject not only to the absolute gravity of Paradise but also to the ordinary physical attraction, **linear gravity**. Range: Of the thirty forms of energy that make up the energy systems of the seven superuniverses, twenty-one belong to this domain of gravita. Summary: the relationship of the three realities and the order of energy transformation Universe energy is materialized in the following order. It passes through the stages of space potency (absoluta) → primordial force (segregata). The ultimata stage: Energy is refined and begins to respond to Paradise gravity, and in this process the **ultimaton**, the basic unit of matter, appears. The gravita stage: Ultimatons gather to form electrons, which in turn are organized into atoms, and only then does it become the "matter" we know and come under the influence of linear gravity. In the end, the ultimaton is the smallest particle produced at the ultimata stage, and as these particles are organized in more complex ways they form gravita, the large-scale matter that responds to linear gravity.

q045.question: What is quantum mechanics, and how is it related to The Urantia Book's concept of the ultimaton?
q045.answer:
**Quantum mechanics** in modern science is the branch of physics that deals with the physical phenomena of the microscopic world, such as molecules, atoms, and electrons. The concept of the ultimaton (an extremely small particle) described in The Urantia Book explains a pre-electronic stage that modern science has not yet reached, yet it has points of remarkable agreement with the core principles of quantum mechanics. Based on the source material provided, here is a brief explanation of quantum mechanics and a summary of what it has in common with the concept of the ultimaton.

1. A brief explanation of quantum mechanics The heart of quantum mechanics is that physical laws which are continuous in the macroscopic world appear in the microscopic world as **"discontinuous units of energy."** Quantization: Energy does not flow continuously; it is exchanged only in whole-number multiples of a certain minimum unit (a quantum). Duality: Microscopic particles have both the properties of a particle (matter) and the properties of a wave (energy). Probabilistic character: The position or velocity of an individual particle cannot be predicted exactly; it exists only probabilistically.

2. Points in common with the concept of the ultimaton ① Discontinuity of energy (quantization) Just as energy exists in definite packets (quanta) in quantum mechanics, The Urantia Book presents the ultimaton as the most basic physical unit of material reality. According to the source, energy can be taken in or given out only in exactly the amount that Urantia scientists call a "quantum," and this is a key mechanism that guarantees the integrity of the material realm. ② Particle-wave duality The particle-wave duality of quantum mechanics agrees with the way light and energy behave as explained in the source. The Urantia Book explains that light and energy particles are actually particle realities that travel in straight lines, but that because of the resistance of space and the interaction of gravity they appear to the observer as wave phenomena. In addition, the emission of solar energy, appearing as tiny fragments of definite length and weight, is described in a way similar to quantum-mechanical waves. ③ The internal structure and composition of the electron Modern science sometimes regards the electron as an elementary particle that cannot be divided further, but The Urantia Book reveals that the electron is a composite made up of one hundred ultimatons. The process by which ultimatons condense along circuits to form electrons is in line with the principles of organization in the subatomic world with which quantum mechanics deals. ④ Unpredictability of individual particles (indeterminism) In quantum mechanics the behavior of an individual particle cannot be predicted with certainty, and The Urantia Book makes a similar statement. According to the source, atoms follow laws statistically, but in their individual behavior they have an aspect of unpredictability similar to that of human beings. This is explained as being due to unknown forces pervading the space within the atom and to the action of the Unqualified Absolute. ⑤ Mutual conversion of mass and energy Like the theory of relativity (E=mc²), which underlies quantum mechanics, The Urantia Book emphasizes that matter and energy are essentially one and can be converted into each other. The ultimaton is formed at the emergent energy stage (ultimata), before it becomes matter, and only when organized into electrons does it acquire the material characteristics that we recognize. In summary, The Urantia Book's concept of the ultimaton links the minimum-unit nature of energy, the wave-particle duality, and the indeterminacy of the microscopic world, which quantum mechanics discovered, with their cosmic origins, and it explains them at a deeper level (the pre-electronic stage).

q046.question: Is there a basis in The Urantia Book for the idea that the dark gravity bodies are aggregations of ultimatons?
q046.answer:
Taking the contents of The Urantia Book as a whole, there is no explicit statement in the source material that the dark gravity bodies are simply aggregations of ultimatons. On the contrary, the source material emphasizes that the dark gravity bodies show a distinctive gravity response that differs from that of ultimatons. The relevant evidence is summarized as follows.

1. Difference in gravity response Dark gravity bodies: The dark gravity bodies circling Havona exhibit both aspects, linear gravity and absolute gravity. That is, they have both the pull toward Paradise and the attraction that operates between ordinary material masses. Ultimatons: The ultimaton, the fundamental unit of material existence, obeys the circular pull of Paradise (absolute gravity), but it does not respond to linear gravity (linear attraction).

2. Distinctiveness in the classification of matter Dark gravity bodies are classified as a distinctive state, being neither **triata**, the energy system of the central universe, nor **gravita**, the physical matter of the superuniverses. If the dark gravity bodies were simply aggregations of unassociated ultimatons, they ought not to respond to linear gravity. But since the dark gravity bodies do exhibit linear gravity, this suggests that they are a special physical form surrounding the central universe, different again from the state in which ultimatons are organized into electrons and become "gravita."

3. Properties of the dark gravity bodies The dark gravity bodies neither reflect nor absorb light; they have a nonreactive nature that does not respond to light energy. Their enormous mass equalizes the gravity lines of Havona and serves to stabilize the central universe physically. In summary, The Urantia Book defines the dark gravity bodies as **"enormous bodies of mass that exert linear gravity and absolute gravity at the same time, being neither triata nor gravita."** Because it is the nature of ultimatons not to respond to linear gravity, there is not enough direct textual evidence to conclude that the dark gravity bodies are simply aggregates of ultimatons; rather, they differ from them in their gravity response.

q047.question: Please tell me in detail about the role of the Universal Censors.
q047.answer:
