According to the teachings of The Urantia Book, the **Universal Censor** is a personality of the tenth order of the "Trinity-origin beings" created directly by the Paradise Trinity. They are described not merely as beings who reflect the judgment of Deity, but as **"the judgment of Deity itself," personifying the collective attitude of Deity in the realm of justice and executive judgment**. The main roles and characteristics of the Universal Censors are set out in detail below.

1. Execution and finality of divine judgment Personification of judgment: The Universal Censor functions as **"the judgment of Deity"** in every judicial process of the universe. They work together with the Perfectors of Wisdom (the past) and the Divine Counselors (the future), and the Censor himself signifies the judgment of the "present." Irreversible verdicts: When a Universal Censor renders his final summary and judgment, no one can dispute it any further, and there is no appeal from his verdict. This is because it is a conclusion reached by divinely integrating all the previous testimony, wisdom, and counsel. An essential element of judgment: Even the Ancients of Days, the rulers of the superuniverse, never render a decision without the Universal Censors.

2. Key members of the "fact-finding tribunal" Composition of the Trinity tribunal: A Universal Censor, usually together with one Perfector of Wisdom and seven Divine Counselors, constitutes a "fact-finding tribunal," or **"tribunal for the revelation of truth."** Reaching divine conclusions: The conclusions reached by this tribunal are regarded as being in accord with the will of the Universal Father, and in the history of the superuniverse not once has a verdict of such a tribunal been reversed by the Ancients of Days.

3. Unifiers and interpreters of the universe Synthesis of experience and divinity: The Universal Censor serves to create new meanings and values by combining the insight of the perfect Creator with the experience of the evolving creature. Connection with the Deity Absolute: The verdicts of the Censors sometimes contain insight so profound as to be difficult to foresee, and this appears to be because they are in some way in contact with the **Deity Absolute**.

4. Numbers and distribution Total number: There are exactly eight billion of them in the whole universe. Distribution: The central universe (Havona): one on each of the billion worlds, a total of one billion, assisting in planetary administration. The superuniverses: one billion in each of the seven superuniverses, working at every level from the superuniverse headquarters down to the councils of the local systems. In relation to Urantia: They participate organically in every dispensational judicial process of the evolutionary worlds and are a central part of the judicial system that determines the eternal survival of human beings. In summary, the Universal Censor, as **"the guarantor of righteous judgment"** in the administration of the grand universe, plays a pivotal role, combining countless testimonies and facts with divine wisdom to render final verdicts that cannot be overturned.

q048.question: Who are the fourteen orders of Trinity-origin beings?
q048.answer: Who are the fourteen orders of Trinity-origin beings? According to the classification of the Uversa Personality Register in the source material provided, the beings classified fourteenth among the Trinity-origin beings are named **Paradise Citizens**. On Uversa living beings are registered in seven grand divisions, and the detailed list of the "Trinity-origin beings" group among them is as follows: Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy, Eternals of Days, Ancients of Days, Perfections of Days, Recents of Days, Unions of Days, Faithfuls of Days, Trinity Teacher Sons, Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, Universal Censors, Inspired Trinity Spirits, Havona Natives, Paradise Citizens. These are personalities who were created directly by the Paradise Trinity or who came into existence in some way related to the Trinity. In particular, the Paradise Citizens include more than three thousand different orders of intelligences residing on Paradise, and they are engaged in the countless activities of the eternal Isle. Among these, how far does the group called the Stationary Sons extend? According to the Urantia text, the beings called the **"⟦Q 19:4.8⟧Stationary Sons of the Trinity⟦/Q⟧"** are personalities of ten orders in all, created by the Paradise Trinity for specific tasks of universe administration and adjudication [10:6.5, 19:4.8]. They are administratively perfect, and their number is final and complete, so that no more are being created [18:0.9]. The specific list is as follows [10:6.5-15, 18:0.2-8]: Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy: a group of seventy who preside over the Paradise satellites, the Father's seven secret spheres [18:1.1]. Eternals of Days: rulers who each supervise one of the billion worlds of the central universe of Havona [18:2.1]. Ancients of Days: the highest rulers who directly govern the seven superuniverses, three in each superuniverse, twenty-one in all [18:3.4-5]. Perfections of Days: rulers who preside over the governments of the major sectors of the superuniverses [18:4.1]. Recents of Days: rulers who direct the affairs of the minor sectors of the superuniverses [18:5.1]. Unions of Days: advisers assigned to the headquarters of each local universe to represent the Paradise Trinity [18:6.1]. Faithfuls of Days: counselors who provide the advice of the Trinity to the rulers of each constellation [18:7.1]. Perfectors of Wisdom: beings who personify divine wisdom in the superuniverses and assist in their administration [19:2.1]. Divine Counselors: Trinity-origin beings who provide the counsel of Deity in the superuniverse tribunals and elsewhere [19:3.1]. Universal Censors: beings who personify the judgment of Deity and serve to reach the final conclusion in every universe judicial process [19:4.1, 19:4.5]. Together these ten groups comprise more than about 37 billion beings, and they form the essential framework of the administration of Havona and the superuniverses [19:4.8]. They have perfect characters that run no risk of ever failing or joining in rebellion, and they carry out the righteous justice of the Paradise Trinity throughout the universes [18:0.11, 10:6.2].

q049.question: What are the main activities of the Paradise Citizens?
q049.answer:
According to the source material, the **Paradise Citizens** are the fourteenth order of the "Trinity-origin beings," who were created directly by the Paradise Trinity or came into existence in a way related to it. They are a vast group composed of more than 3,000 different orders of intelligences, and their main activities are as follows.

1. Engagement in the countless activities of Paradise The Paradise Citizens reside on the eternal Isle of Paradise and are engaged in the innumerable activities that take place there. They occupy the first and innermost zone of the "Holy Land" of Paradise and dwell there together with the Havona natives.

2. The joint adventure of "trinitization" with the finaliters One of their most distinctive and important activities is the attempt at **"trinitization,"** in which they co-operate with the Corps of the Finality (finaliters) to bring new beings into existence. Under the perfect conditions of Paradise, a mortal finaliter and a Paradise Citizen unite in an effort to actualize a universe concept, and if they succeed, **"Creature-trinitized Sons"** are born. The beings so born mostly manifest concepts related to future universe ages, and at present they are devoted to special study and training in the sector of Vicegerington.

3. Assistance and fellowship for ascending mortals When ascending mortals reach Paradise, the Paradise Citizens help them adapt to their new environment and associate with higher intelligences. Support in social adjustment: Until the Paradise arrivals attain residential status and are mustered into the Corps of the Finality, the Paradise Citizens help them to mingle harmoniously with the many groups of beings on Paradise. Companionship: They also co-operate with the Paradise Companions in providing personal fellowship and friendship to ascending mortals.

4. Carrying out and reflecting the plan of the grand universe Since the last group of Paradise Citizens was personalized at the time the plans for the creation of the seven superuniverses of time and space were promulgated, they are closely associated with the organization and administration of the grand universe. They sometimes meet the pilgrims of time on the seven circuits of Havona, and as Paradise-Havona personalities they carry out various purposes of the universe. In summary, the Paradise Citizens maintain the eternal operation of Paradise while at the same time helping in the final training of ascending mortals and taking an active part in the divine adventure of creating new orders of beings in preparation for future universe ages.
